snippet.title: How to Add Deskworm to OBS Studio (Free Desktop Pet Overlay!)
snippet.description:
In this quick tutorial, I'll show you how to easily bring the free desktop pet "Deskworm" into OBS Studio and customize it for your Twitch or YouTube streams! Having a little companion on your screen is a great way to fill empty space and make your stream overlay unique. 🪱✨

🎮 Get Deskworm for FREE on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4044170/Deskworm/

💬 Join the official Deskworm Discord:
https://discord.gg/7srFxfNWF3

⏳ Chapters:
0:00 - Intro & Recommended Setup
0:28 - Setup in OBS
1:32 - Crucial Tip for Streamers: Admin Mode
1:55 - "Always on Top" Setting Explained
2:10 - Setting up a Custom Play Area & Cropping in OBS
2:46 - Tips & Tricks
3:20 - Outro

#Deskworm #OBSStudio #StreamOverlay #DesktopPet #TwitchTips #StreamerSetup
